items.title: Earl Humphrey Interview, 1968-11-30
items.q: Buddy joined us in the Orleans with Lee Collins and Earl Humphrey's band... he stayed with us for about two months.

ctx.x: All right, now, we're talking to Earl Humphrey. Today is November 30th, 1968. Now, could you tell us about when you were playing with Buddy Petit? What is all you can remember about Buddy Petit?

Well, I suppose it must have been just about 1926. And we had a gig over in Mandeville every other Saturday night. In the hotel. Buddy was stationed over there with another man. And it looks as though he had gotten tired of being over there, kind of lonesome, just working on weekends. So he decided to come home and join us in the Orleans with Lee Collins and Earl Humphrey's band. That was our band. So you mean you had two companies? We only had one until Buddy joined us. So Buddy, he got on the train. We wasn't…
Tell me, what's George Lewis in that band?
